verdict.rationale: Airbyte docs describe local/self-hosted deployment options (OSS quickstart, abctl) and PyAirbyte for Python-based testing, which could be used to build a non-production sandbox, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated sandbox/staging mode, test-data isolation, or guidance for testing without touching production data. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-environment feature, documentation on isolating test runs from production data, and any hands-on evidence of using it this way.
